author: nickyeow

english.text: I will never sell my friend down the river for anything in the world.

jyutping: faat3 saang1 me1 si6 dou1 hou2，ngo5 dim2 dou1 m4 wui5 ceot1 maai6 ngo5 baan1 pang4 jau5。
text: 發生咩事都好，我點都唔會出賣我班朋友。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I wonder if you don't get tired of doing the same thing every day.

jyutping: nei5 jat6 jat6 dou1 hai6 zou6 maai4 di1 jat1 mou4 jat1 joeng6 ge3 je5，mat1 m4 wui5 gok3 dak1 mun6 ge3 me1？
text: 你日日都係做埋啲一模一樣嘅嘢，乜唔會覺得悶嘅咩？

author: nickyeow

english.text: Never go across the street without looking for cars first.

jyutping: gwo3 maa5 lou6 zi1 cin4 jat1 ding6 jiu3 tai2 cing1 co2 jau5 mou5 ce1 sin1。
text: 過馬路之前一定要睇清楚有冇車先。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I don't remember where I put my key.

jyutping: ngo5 seng2 m4 hei2 ngo5 baai2 zo2 tiu4 so2 si4 hai2 bin1 dou6。
text: 我醒唔起我擺咗條鎖匙喺邊度。

author: kaenif

english.text: Take him away.

jyutping: daai3 keoi5 zau2。
text: 帶佢走。

author: nickyeow

english.text: He was scared you would shoot him.

jyutping: keoi5 hou2 geng1 nei5 wui5 hoi1 coeng1 se6 keoi5。
text: 佢好驚你會開槍射佢。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Do you come here every day?

jyutping: nei5 hai6 mai5 mui5 jat6 dou1 lai4 ni1 dou6 gaa3？
text: 你係咪每日都嚟呢度㗎？

author: nickyeow

english.text: "Who here has a panda at home?" "I do!"

jyutping: 「ni1 dou6 jau5 mou5 jan2 uk1 kei2 joeng5 hung4 maau1 gaa3？」「ngo5！」
text: 「呢度有冇人屋企養熊貓㗎？」「我！」

author: fercheung

english.text: I see a man between the trees.

jyutping: ngo5 gin3 dou2 jau5 go3 naam4 jan2 hai2 loeng5 fo2 syu6 zi1 gaan1。
text: 我見到有個男人喺兩棵樹之間。

author: kaenif

english.text: He's not an idiot.

jyutping: keoi5 m4 hai6 baak6 ci1。
text: 佢唔係白癡。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I love music, particularly classical.

jyutping: ngo5 hou3 zung1 ji3 jam1 ngok6，jau4 kei4 hai6 gu2 din2 jam1 ngok6。
text: 我好鍾意音樂，尤其係古典音樂。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I want you to sit down.

jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 nei5 co5 dai1。
text: 我想你坐低。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I'll protect them.

jyutping: ngo5 wui5 bou2 wu6 keoi5 dei6 gaa3 laa3。
text: 我會保護佢哋㗎喇。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I can't sleep at night.

jyutping: ngo5 je6 maan5 fan3 m4 zoek6 gok3。
text: 我夜晚瞓唔著覺。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Was it a lie when you said you loved me?

jyutping: nei5 go2 zan6 waa6 nei5 oi3 ngo5 hai6 mai6 ngaak1 ngo5 gaa3？
text: 你嗰陣話你愛我係咪呃我㗎？

author: nickyeow

english.text: Thanks for your concern.

jyutping: do1 ze6 nei5 gwaan1 sam1 aa3。
text: 多謝你關心呀。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I shouldn't have made this many sandwiches.

jyutping: ngo5 m4 jing1 goi1 zing2 gam3 do1 gin6 saam1 man4 zi6。
text: 我唔應該整咁多件三文治。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I can only pay 100 dollars at most.

jyutping: ngo5 zeoi3 do1 bei2 dou3 jat1 baak3 man1。
text: 我最多俾到一百蚊。

author: LeeSooHa

english.text: If I had a lot of money, I would buy a car.

jyutping: jyu4 gwo2 ngo5 jau5 hou2 do1 cin4，ngo5 zau6 wui5 maai5 ce1。
text: 如果我有好多錢，我就會買車。

author: bearyung

english.text: Do you think that I don't know what's happening?

jyutping: nei5 ji5 wai4 ngo5 m4 zi1 faat3 sang1 gan2 me1 si6?
text: 你以為我唔知發生緊咩事?

author: thesilhouette

english.text: Everyone is wearing name tags.

jyutping: go3 go3 dou1 daai3 zyu6 ming4 paai4。
text: 個個都戴住名牌。

author: thesilhouette

english.text: You are very arrogant.

jyutping: nei5 zan1 hai6 hou2 hiu1 zoeng1。
text: 你真係好囂張。

english.text: If these officials are already familiar with our disaster relief efforts, it will be easier for us to get their approval to enter the disaster area when a disaster occurs.

jyutping: jyu4 gwo2 ni1 di1 gun1 jyun4 ji5 ging1 suk6 sik1 saai3 ngo5 dei6 di1 zan3 zoi1 gung1 zok3，dong1 faat3 sang1 zoi1 naan6 go2 zan6，ngo5 dei6 zau6 bei2 gaau3 jung4 ji6 gam2 dak1 dou3 keoi5 dei6 ge3 pai1 zeon2，zeon3 jap6 zoi1 keoi1。
text: 如果呢啲官員已經熟悉晒我哋啲賑災工作，當發生災難嗰陣，我哋就比較容易噉得到佢哋嘅批准，進入災區。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: I had not been in my study five minutes when the maid entered to say that a person desired to see me. To my astonishment it was none other than my strange old book collector, his sharp, wizened face peering out from a frame of white hair, and his precious volumes, a dozen of them at least, wedged under his right arm.

jyutping: ngo5 mei6 hai2 ngo5 go3 syu1 fong2 jap6 min6 ng5 fan1 zung1，go3 neoi5 buk6 zau6 jap6 lai4 waa6 jau5 go3 jan4 soeng2 gin3 ngo5。ling6 ngo5 ging1 ngaa6 ge3 hai6，ni1 bun2 syu1 bing6 m4 hai6 kei4 taa1 jan4，ji4 hai6 ngo5 go3 kei4 gwaai3 ge3 gau6 syu1 sau1 cong4 gaa1，keoi5 go3 fung1 lei6、zau3 man4 ge3 lim5 cung4 jat1 tiu4 baak6 faat3 kwaang1 dou6 mong6 ceot1 lai4，ji4 keoi5 di1 zan1 gwai3 ge3 syu1，zi3 siu2 jau5 sap6 gei2 bun2，sit3 hai2 keoi5 jau6 sau2 bei3 haa6 min6。
text: 我未喺我個書房入面五分鐘，個女僕就入嚟話有個人想見我。令我驚訝嘅係，呢本書並唔係其他人，而係我個奇怪嘅舊書收藏家，佢個鋒利、皺紋嘅臉從一條白髮框度望出嚟，而佢啲珍貴嘅書，至少有十幾本，楔喺佢右手臂下面。
